question: Structural formula of branched chain organic compound 'Neopentane' may be represented by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**C(CH₃)₄**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Neopentane**, also known as 2,2-dimethylpropane, is a **branched-chain alkane** with the chemical formula C₅H₁₂. It is one of the three structural isomers of pentane.
 
• The structural formula of neopentane is represented as **C(CH₃)₄**, where a central carbon atom is bonded to four methyl groups.
 
• Neopentane has a highly symmetrical and compact structure due to the branching, making it different from n-pentane and isopentane.
 
• Among the given options, the representation **C(CH₃)₄** accurately depicts the structure of neopentane, where the central carbon atom is surrounded by four methyl groups.
